report_name: American Addiction Centers Discloses Salesforce Data Breach

threat_actors.name: Unauthorized Party
threat_actors.description: An unnamed threat actor who gained unauthorized access to the Salesforce CRM environment of American Addiction Centers on May 12, 2026, and exfiltrated sensitive patient inquiry data.
threat_actors.goals: Data theft of personal and health information.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts
attack_patterns.description: An unauthorized party gained access to the American Addiction Centers' Salesforce CRM environment. The article suggests this could have been through credential stuffing, password spraying, or phishing to obtain valid employee cloud account credentials.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: The unauthorized party exfiltrated sensitive data, including names, Social Security numbers, and health descriptions, from the compromised Salesforce cloud environment.

identities.name: American Addiction Centers
identities.description: A national provider of substance abuse treatment whose Salesforce CRM environment was breached, exposing the sensitive personal and health information of potential patients.

identities.name: Salesforce
identities.description: The third-party CRM platform used by American Addiction Centers where the data breach occurred. The platform itself was not breached, but an instance belonging to AAC was compromised.

indicators.name: Suspicious Salesforce Login
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Salesforce Login
id: 2b8c1f9a-5d7e-4b0c-8a1d-9f6e3c2b1a0e
status: experimental
description: Detects Salesforce logins from unusual locations, which could indicate account compromise.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-09
references:
  - https://www.cyber.net/reports/american-addiction-centers-discloses-salesforce-data-breach
tags:
  - attack.t1078.004
  - attack.initial_access
level: medium
logsource:
  product: salesforce
  category: authentication
detection:
  selection:
    event_type: 'Login'
    login_status: 'Success'
  filter:
    source_country|endswith: 'US'
  condition: selection and not filter
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate employee travel or remote work.
indicators.description: Detects Salesforce logins from unusual IP addresses, locations, user agents, or outside of normal business hours, as suggested in the report's hunting hints.

indicators.name: Anomalous Salesforce Data Export
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Salesforce Data Export
id: 8f3d2a1b-9c8e-4f0a-b1d2-c3b4a5d6e7f8
status: experimental
description: Detects a high volume of data being exported from Salesforce via reports or API calls, which can indicate data exfiltration.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-09
references:
  - https://www.cyber.net/reports/american-addiction-centers-discloses-salesforce-data-breach
tags:
  - attack.t1530
  - attack.collection
level: high
logsource:
  product: salesforce
  category: api
detection:
  selection:
    event_type: 'ReportExport'
    # This rule is conceptual. A real implementation would require aggregation and thresholding.
    # For example: count(event_type='ReportExport') by user > threshold within a time window.
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate bulk data export operations by administrators or data analysts.
indicators.description: Detects high-volume API calls or report exports from Salesforce, which can be a sign of data exfiltration as noted in the report.

indicators.name: Suspicious Salesforce Configuration Change
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Salesforce Configuration Change
id: e4a5b6c7-d8e9-4f0a-b1c2-d3e4f5a6b7c8
status: experimental
description: Monitors the Salesforce Setup Audit Trail for unexpected changes to security settings, user permissions, or sharing rules.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-09
references:
  - https://www.cyber.net/reports/american-addiction-centers-discloses-salesforce-data-breach
tags:
  - attack.t1098.003
  - attack.privilege_escalation
level: medium
logsource:
  product: salesforce
  category: configuration
detection:
  selection:
    event_source: 'SetupAuditTrail'
    action|contains:
      - 'Changed Sharing' # Example keyword for sharing rule changes
      - 'Changed Profile' # Example for permission changes
      - 'Changed Security' # Example for security setting changes
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative changes to Salesforce configuration.
indicators.description: Detects unexpected changes to security settings, user permissions, or sharing rules by monitoring the Salesforce Setup Audit Trail, as recommended in the report.
